privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting data for ENSMENU users and the businesses that use our platform.
privacy.closingCard: We are building a modern, secure hospitality platform for everyone.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body:
ENSMENU is an Egyptian cloud platform owned by ENS.EG, operating via ens.eg and ensmenu.com, built for restaurants, cafés, hotels, and hospitality businesses.

We collect data only to operate the platform and deliver smart menus, QR ordering, notifications, and AI menu import — not for unrelated commercial purposes.

By using ENSMENU you acknowledge the practices described in this policy.

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.body:
We may collect the following when you register or use the platform:
• Name
• Email address
• Phone number
• Business data (trade name, type, address, branches)
• Menu data (categories, items, prices, descriptions, modifiers)
• Item images, logos, and backgrounds
• Usage data within the dashboard and public menu
• IP addresses, browser, and device information
• System logs and technical error records
• Order data (table, items, time, status)
• Cookies

sections.heading: How we use data
sections.body:
We use collected data to:
• Operate the platform and display digital menus and QR orders
• Improve performance, load times, and service stability
• Provide customer support
• Send staff and admin notifications (new orders, account updates)
• Protect accounts and prevent unauthorised access
• Prevent abuse, fraud, and harmful content
• Develop new features for hospitality businesses
• Improve AI menu import models (without selling your data to third parties)

sections.heading: Data protection
sections.body:
We protect your data through:
• HTTPS encryption between browser and servers
• Reasonable security measures on cloud infrastructure
• Limiting data access on a need-to-know basis
• Periodic review of systems and permissions

We do not sell your personal or business data to third parties for marketing.

sections.heading: Artificial intelligence
sections.body:
ENSMENU offers AI menu import. When you upload menu images or files, they may be analysed automatically to extract categories, items, prices, and descriptions.

Please note:
• AI may sometimes misread text or prices
• You must review imported data and correct it before publishing
• Once you confirm and publish content, you are responsible for menu accuracy
• ENSMENU is not liable for incorrect content you confirmed and published after review

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body:
We use cookies and local storage to:
• Keep your login session active
• Remember language and theme (light/dark)
• Save basic usage preferences
• Measure performance and improve user experience

You can configure your browser to refuse some cookies; this may affect certain platform features.

sections.heading: Data sharing
sections.body:
ENSMENU does not sell customer or business data to third parties.

We may share limited data only with:
• Payment providers for subscriptions and billing
• Cloud hosting providers to operate the platform
• Authorities when legally required or under court order

These providers are bound to protect data within the scope of their service.

sections.heading: User responsibility
sections.body:
You are responsible for:
• Content you upload (text, images, prices)
• Copyright and intellectual property of images and materials used
• Legality of menu items and prices shown to customers
• Not publishing prohibited, misleading, or infringing content

Your business bears full responsibility for what visitors see via your ENSMENU menu.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body:
Under applicable law you may:
• Request correction of your account or business data
• Request deletion of your account and associated data
• Request a copy of personal data we hold about you
• Contact support for any privacy-related inquiry

We aim to respond within a reasonable timeframe.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body:
For privacy questions or data requests, contact us at:
• Email: info@ensmenu.com
• WhatsApp: +20 150 080 0050

The ENSMENU team — part of ENS.EG — is here to help.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
sections.body:
By using ensmenu.com, ens.eg, ENSMENU apps, or the dashboard, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.

If you do not agree, please stop using the platform. We may update these terms from time to time; continued use may constitute acceptance of the updated version where permitted by law.

sections.heading: Service description
sections.body:
ENSMENU provides a complete solution for creating and managing digital menus:
• Digital menus and QR menus for restaurants, cafés, and hotels
• AI menu import from images and files
• Smart table ordering via QR
• Dashboard to manage items, branches, and tables
• Staff notifications for new orders
• Share your digital menu with guests via a custom link or QR code

Available features may vary depending on your plan (free, Pro, or custom).

sections.heading: Accounts
sections.body:
You are responsible for:
• Accuracy of registration and business information
• Keeping your password and login credentials secure
• All activity under your account
• Notifying us promptly of suspected unauthorised access

You must be of legal age to enter a contract in your country to use the platform on behalf of a business.

sections.heading: Permitted use
sections.body:
The platform is intended for lawful commercial use in hospitality, including:
• Restaurants, cafés, and hotels
• Quick-service venues and bakeries
• Hospitality events displaying a digital menu

You must use ENSMENU in compliance with applicable local and international laws.

sections.heading: Prohibited use
sections.body:
You may not use the platform to:
• Publish illegal or fraudulent content
• Create fake restaurants or businesses
• Phish or impersonate others
• Upload malware or attempt to compromise systems
• Send spam or abuse notifications
• Use copyrighted material without permission
• Abuse the platform or overload infrastructure

sections.heading: Artificial intelligence
sections.body:
ENSMENU AI menu import is an assistive tool only, not a substitute for human review.

• Results may contain errors in items, prices, or descriptions
• You must review every imported field before publishing
• Once you confirm and publish, you are responsible for displayed content
• ENSMENU is not liable for financial or operational losses from incorrect menu data you confirmed and published

sections.heading: Payment and subscriptions
sections.body:
ENSMENU offers multiple plans:
• Free plans with limited features
• Pro subscriptions with advanced features
• Custom plans for hotels and large chains

Prices and features may change later with reasonable notice where required by law. Subscriptions may be paused or features restricted if payment fails or the paid period ends.

sections.heading: Suspension or deletion
sections.body:
ENSMENU may suspend or delete accounts that:
• Violate these terms or applicable laws
• Publish harmful or misleading content
• Abuse the platform or threaten its security

You may request account closure anytime via support. We may retain certain records for legal or security requirements.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body:
ENSMENU is provided "as is" and "as available". We are not liable for:
• Internet outages or connectivity provider issues
• Payment provider failures or transaction delays
• User-uploaded content (text, images, prices)
• Temporary downtime for maintenance or updates
• AI errors after you confirmed and published content manually

We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body:
ENSMENU branding, design, interfaces, software, and source code belong to ENS.EG or its licensors.

You retain rights to content you upload, while granting ENSMENU a non-exclusive licence to host and display it to operate the service.

Copying or reselling the platform or its parts without written permission is prohibited.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body:
We may modify these terms or platform features from time to time. The last updated date is shown at the top of this page.

We recommend reviewing this page periodically. Continued use of ENSMENU after changes means acceptance of updated terms where permitted by law.

sections.heading: Contact

items.question: Can I create a QR menu for free?
items.answer: Yes. You can create a fully free digital menu for your restaurant or cafe in minutes, add items, prices, and photos, and get a QR code ready to use—no hassle.

items.question: What is the difference between the free plan and paid subscription?
items.answer: The free plan covers the essentials to run a professional menu. Paid plans add features such as full design control, brand colours, promotions or ads, and a richer experience for your guests (see current pricing for details).

items.question: Does the menu support Arabic and English?
items.answer: Yes. The platform supports Arabic and English so you can choose what works for your customers—ideal for locals and tourists alike.

items.question: Is the dashboard easy to use?
items.answer: We built a simple, fast dashboard where you can add or edit items and prices, update your menu anytime, and see changes go live without technical skills.

items.question: Can I manage more than one menu or branch?
items.answer: It depends on your plan: the free tier often allows one active menu, while higher plans support multiple menus or advanced features. Check pricing or your dashboard for your current limits.

items.question: How do I share the menu with customers?
items.answer: After you publish your menu you get a direct link and a QR code. Put the code on tables, printed menus, or social media—customers scan or tap the link and browse instantly.

items.question: Is my restaurant data and menu protected?
items.answer: We work to keep the platform secure and host your data with reasonable safeguards. Read our privacy policy for details on collection and use, and use a strong password—never share login credentials.

items.question: What if I need help or run into an issue?
items.answer: Contact us via WhatsApp or email as shown on the site—we can help you set up your menu or troubleshoot technical issues.

items.question: Can I customise the menu look, colours, and logo?
items.answer: Yes. Depending on your plan you can upload a logo and adjust colours and layout to match your brand; higher tiers offer broader design control.
